scope: Local redesign and functionality/SEO improvement; no publication, push, deployment, database change or indexing request.

baseline.head: 3bcb5f8455e5316258e252b7602766390ce9b36b
baseline.liveAudit: Page opened read-only. Default single-text uniqueness heuristics and optional Groq estimates were presented alongside unconditional in-browser/privacy claims. Two-text lexical comparison existed, but no actual web corpus search was implemented.
observedProblems: Writing style and generic phrasing were used to estimate uniqueness without matched sources.
Optional AI requests sent up to 5,000 characters to Groq despite page-wide no-upload claims.
Unlimited and sub-second claims lacked bounds or measurements.
Results could remain visible after their inputs changed.
No file import, review notes or useful report export.

keywordResearch.method: Ten Google autocomplete requests using English/US URL parameters and public Google/Bing result inspection. The selections below preserve observed wording, not an exhaustive keyword export.

phrases: compare two texts for plagiarism free
compare two texts side by side

keywordResearch.limitations: No measured search volume, keyword difficulty, rankings, click forecast or fresh authenticated GSC report. Document-comparison searches can include PDF/Word editing intent outside this tool's scope.

competitors.observation: Advertises multiple documents, text/file/URL inputs, semantic matching and PDF reports. Not benchmarked or submitted private documents. Multiple sources alone are not a unique feature.
Advertises side-by-side text comparison, word/character highlights, ignore rules and review/export options; some features are Pro-limited. Observed marketing, not an accuracy test.

sources.supports: Similarity matches need interpretation; properly quoted and referenced text can match. ByteVerse neither uses Turnitin's database nor claims equivalence or endorsement.
Quoting, paraphrasing and summarizing require attribution. Rewording is not a way to remove citation obligations.
Ordinary duplicate content is not a blanket spam violation; abusive copying is different.
Descriptive, concise and accurate titles; no fixed length or ranking guarantee.
Snippets can use page content and vary with the query; a supplied description is not guaranteed display text.

implementation.positioning: Source-backed review, not originality certification. Existing URL and canonical retained.
implementation.comparison: Main draft against 1–5 labeled supplied sources. Normalized exact word sequences, 4/6/8/12-word threshold, union-based directional coverage and original-text evidence/highlights. No AI or semantic/internet corpus search.
implementation.singleText: Exact normalized repeated-sentence groups, occurrence navigation and optional position-sampled manual search excerpts. No suspicion or originality score.
implementation.limits: 10,000 words and 60,000 UTF-16 characters per text; UTF-8 TXT/MD files up to 256 KB; no PDF/DOCX/URL/OCR import; 15-second cancellable worker deadline.
implementation.exclusions: Balanced supported quotations and final explicit References/Bibliography/Works Cited heading. Applied to both texts; excluded gaps cannot be bridged. Recognition does not validate citations.
implementation.report: TXT copy/download with settings, counts, positions and user review labels/notes. Optional text omission and an explicit stats-only fallback above the 120,000-character repeated-evidence budget.
implementation.retiredApi: Old AI originality endpoint now returns HTTP 410 without parsing the body, calling a provider or returning a score; cached clients receive a reload explanation.
implementation.privacy: Comparison runs locally and does not automatically persist text. Manual Google search shares only the shown query after an explicit link click. Global site ads/analytics are separate; no absolute all-site privacy claim.

seo.title: Free Text Similarity Checker - Compare Sources
seo.description: Compare a draft with up to five supplied sources, review matching phrases and save a report. Free text similarity checker with on-device matching; no web scan.
seo.structuredData: WebApplication, BreadcrumbList, and five FAQs matching visible content. No invented reviews or aggregate ratings.
seo.discovery: Central tool catalog, homepage, llms.txt, chatbot tool catalog and relevant inbound tool descriptions reflect supplied-source matching, not web scans or originality guarantees.
seo.image: Custom 1200x630 PNG Open Graph/Twitter image with clearly fictional matching-text illustration.

validation.core: 47 tests including 512 seeded brute-force comparisons, adversarial bounds, Unicode spans, exclusions and directional coverage
validation.uiAndReport: 54 tests including 88-million-character potential evidence expansion guarded by stats-only fallback, privacy omission, import boundaries, escaped highlighting, schema parity and retired endpoint behavior
validation.build: Final credential-free copied Next16.2.6 Turbopack production build passed (101 static pages). Database/provider configuration absent; this is not a production-blog-data build. Original invoice preview was not rebuilt or restarted.

browser.results: Real Next-built workers, supplied-source comparisons, source-specific highlights, quote/reference exclusions, notes and report privacy, imports/replacement/cancellation, late results, actual UTF-8 downloads, served metadata/PNG/FAQ/schema and route-specific 410 noindex headers passed.
browser.faultInjection: Explicit controlled clipboard success/rejection/delay, delayed native worker deliveries, worker errors and File.arrayBuffer failures were tested separately from normal paths. System clipboard content was not read.
browser.networkBoundary: No tested input-bearing requests. External page integrations were blocked and counted separately. Manual Google queries were previewed and inspected, never sent. This is not a zero-network or no-storage claim for the entire site.
browser.artifacts: OS-temp byteverse-similarity-browser-xn0fcD; screenshots, two independently read TXT downloads and artifacts.json are outside the repository.

validation.regressions: 42-tool catalog/schema test, SEO Title Checker tests, 19 Meta Tag Generator tests and 14 Invoice SEO/discovery/privacy-build groups passed. TypeScript and focused lint passed; two pre-existing unused-relatedTools warnings remain in neighboring pages.
reviewFixes: Failed or cancelled imports preserve completed reviews until replacement is accepted.
Source-filtered highlighting uses that source's ranges, not the overall union.
Reports are generated only when opened and fall back explicitly to stats-only above the text budget. Long evidence cards are abbreviated without truncating the full highlighted documents.
Pending clipboard copies are single-flight and warn if the preview changes before completion.
A specific Next header rule preserves noindex/no-store on the retired API despite the broad site indexing header.
Browser harness identifies only Edge's actual internal downloads-hub page; it does not ignore external popups. Individual hub closure hung, so isolated browser-context cleanup handles it.
validation.limitations: No plagiarism-detection accuracy benchmark, real confidential documents, GSC traffic impact, live deployment or fresh security remediation claimed. Existing Next16.2.6 security advisory remains separate and unresolved.

measurementPlan: After an explicitly approved release, inspect the exact canonical URL in Search Console and compare page/query clicks, impressions and CTR over complete comparable 28-day periods, or 90 days if sparse. Check indexing and query intent before inferring a cause. Tool usefulness can be evaluated by completed reviews and feedback without logging supplied text; no analytics instrumentation added in this task.
